name: shadcn-combobox
title: Combobox
description: shadcn style-lane combobox wrapper backed by the existing Combobox component.

files.content:
export {
  AnchorCombobox,
  AttachComboboxPreventBlur,
  AttachComboboxSelectOnFocus,
  ClickItem,
  CompletedAnchorCombobox,
  CompletedAttachComboboxPreventBlur,
  CompletedAttachComboboxSelectOnFocus,
  CompletedClickItem,
  CompletedFocusInput,
  CompletedInertOthers,
  CompletedLockScroll,
  CompletedPortalComboboxBackdrop,
  CompletedRestoreInert,
  CompletedScrollIntoView,
  CompletedUnlockScroll,
  create,
  DetectMovementOrAnimationEnd,
  FocusInput,
  GotAnimationMessage,
  InertOthers,
  init,
  LockScroll,
  Message,
  Model,
  Multi,
  OutMessage,
  PortalComboboxBackdrop,
  RestoreInert,
  ScrollIntoView,
  Selected,
  UnlockScroll,
} from "../combobox";
export type {
  ActivationTrigger,
  ActivatedItem,
  AnchorConfig,
  BlurredInput,
  Closed,
  Commands,
  DeactivatedItem,
  GroupHeading,
  InitConfig,
  InitReturn,
  ItemConfig,
  Model as ComboboxModel,
  MovedPointerOverItem,
  Opened,
  OutMessage as ComboboxOutMessage,
  PressedToggleButton,
  RequestedItemClick,
  Selected as ComboboxSelected,
  SelectedItem,
  UpdatedInputValue,
  UpdateReturn,
  ViewInputs,
} from "../combobox";

export {
  shadcnComboboxBackdropClassName,
  shadcnComboboxButtonClassName,
  shadcnComboboxEmptyTagClassName,
  shadcnComboboxInputClassName,
  shadcnComboboxInputWrapperClassName,
  shadcnComboboxItemClassName,
  shadcnComboboxItemsClassName,
  shadcnComboboxSelectedIconClassName,
  shadcnComboboxTagClassName,
  shadcnComboboxWrapperClassName,
} from "./view";

export {
  backdropClassName as shadcnComboboxBackdropClassName,
  buttonClassName as shadcnComboboxButtonClassName,
  emptyTagClassName as shadcnComboboxEmptyTagClassName,
  inputClassName as shadcnComboboxInputClassName,
  inputWrapperClassName as shadcnComboboxInputWrapperClassName,
  itemClassName as shadcnComboboxItemClassName,
  itemsClassName as shadcnComboboxItemsClassName,
  selectedIconClassName as shadcnComboboxSelectedIconClassName,
  tagClassName as shadcnComboboxTagClassName,
  wrapperClassName as shadcnComboboxWrapperClassName,
} from "../combobox/view";
